lines.beaver: 요즘 얼굴이 밝아 보여요. 무슨 일 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: You look bright these days. Did something happen?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum eolguri balga boyeoyo. museun il isseoyo?
lines.learner: 서울에 온 지 석 달인데 이제 좀 적응됐어요.
lines.en: It's been three months in Seoul, and I've finally adjusted a bit.
lines.roman: seoure on ji seok darinde ije jom jeogeungdwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You had a hard time at first, didn't you?
lines.learner: 네, 처음엔 외로움 때문에 정신적으로 힘들었어요.
lines.en: Yes, at first loneliness made it mentally hard.
lines.roman: ne, cheoeumen oeroum ttaemune jeongsinjeogeuro himdeureosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 가족 생각도 많이 났죠? 연락은 자주 해요?
lines.beaver_en: You must miss your family. Do you contact them often?
lines.beaver_roman: gajok saenggakdo mani natjyo? yeollageun jaju haeyo?
lines.learner: 매일 해요. 그래도 그리움은 쉽게 안 없어지더라고요.
lines.en: Every day. Still, the longing doesn't go away easily.
lines.roman: maeil haeyo. geuraedo geuriumeun swipge an eopseojideoragoyo.

lines.en: I reached out to people first.

lines.beaver: 회사 사람들이요? 처음엔 좀 불편하다고 했잖아요.
lines.beaver_en: Your coworkers? You said they felt awkward at first.
lines.beaver_roman: hoesa saramdeuriyo? cheoeumen jom bulpyeonhadago haetjanayo.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 처음엔 친절한 게 오히려 의심이 됐어요.
lines.en: Right. At first their kindness actually made me suspicious.
lines.roman: majayo. cheoeumen chinjeolhan ge ohiryeo uisimi dwaesseoyo.

lines.learner: 지금은 호감이 생겼어요. 특히 옆자리 지수 씨요.
lines.en: Now I like them. Especially Jisu, who sits next to me.
lines.roman: jigeumeun hogami saenggyeosseoyo. teukhi yeopjari jisu ssiyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 지수 씨 얘기할 때 표정이 좋네요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, your face lights up when you talk about Jisu.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, jisu ssi yaegihal ttae pyojeongi jonneyo.
lines.learner: 문제는 머릿속에 자꾸 지수 씨가 떠오른다는 거예요.
lines.en: The thing is, Jisu keeps popping into my head.
lines.roman: munjeneun meoritsoge jakku jisu ssiga tteooreundaneun geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Could it be that you like her?
lines.learner: 잘 모르겠어요. 마음이 앞설까 봐 걱정돼요.
lines.en: I'm not sure. I'm worried my heart is running ahead.
lines.roman: jal moreugesseoyo. maeumi apseolkka bwa geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, how do you feel these days?
lines.learner: 확실한 건 이제 덜 외롭다는 점이에요.
lines.en: What's certain is that I'm less lonely now.
lines.roman: hwaksilhan geon ije deol oeropdaneun jeomieyo.

lines.beaver: 잘됐네요. 천천히 맘 가는 대로 해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: I'm glad. Take it slow and follow your heart.
lines.beaver_roman: jaldwaenneyo. cheoncheonhi mam ganeun daero hae bwayo.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 다음에 또 얘기 들어 줘요.
lines.en: Thanks. Please listen to me again next time.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. daeume tto yaegi deureo jwoyo.
